type Checksum struct {
	Algorithm	string	`json:"algorithm" yaml:"algorithm"`

	Value	string	`json:"value" yaml:"value"`
}
type ChecksumMismatchError struct {
	Want	string

	Got	string
}
type Code string
type DecodeError struct {
	Path	string

	Reason	string

	Line	int
}
type DecodeInfo struct {
	UnknownFields []string
}
type EntryKind string
type Experimentation struct {
	Start	*"time".Time	`json:"start,omitempty" yaml:"start,omitempty"`
	End	*"time".Time	`json:"end,omitempty"   yaml:"end,omitempty"`
}
type FieldError struct {
	Path	string

	Reason	string

	Code	Code

	Kind	EntryKind

	Name	string

	Index	int
}
type Flag struct {
	TrackEvents		*bool			`json:"trackEvents,omitempty"      yaml:"trackEvents,omitempty"`
	Disable			*bool			`json:"disable,omitempty"          yaml:"disable,omitempty"`
	Version			*string			`json:"version,omitempty"          yaml:"version,omitempty"`
	Converter		*string			`json:"converter,omitempty"        yaml:"converter,omitempty"`
	Variations		map[string]any		`json:"variations,omitempty"       yaml:"variations,omitempty"`
	Targeting		[]Rule			`json:"targeting,omitempty"        yaml:"targeting,omitempty"`
	BucketingKey		*string			`json:"bucketingKey,omitempty"     yaml:"bucketingKey,omitempty"`
	DefaultRule		*Rule			`json:"defaultRule,omitempty"      yaml:"defaultRule,omitempty"`
	ScheduledRollout	[]ScheduledStep		`json:"scheduledRollout,omitempty" yaml:"scheduledRollout,omitempty"`
	Experimentation		*Experimentation	`json:"experimentation,omitempty"  yaml:"experimentation,omitempty"`
	Metadata		map[string]any		`json:"metadata,omitempty"         yaml:"metadata,omitempty"`
}
type FlagSet struct {
	Name	string	`json:"name" yaml:"name"`

	Sources	[]string	`json:"sources" yaml:"sources"`

	SegmentSources	[]string	`json:"segmentSources,omitempty" yaml:"segmentSources,omitempty"`

	APIKeys	[]string	`json:"apiKeys,omitempty" yaml:"apiKeys,omitempty"`
}
type FlagSetDocument struct {
	APIVersion	string	`json:"apiVersion" yaml:"apiVersion"`

	Kind	string	`json:"kind" yaml:"kind"`

	FlagSets	[]FlagSet	`json:"flagSets" yaml:"flagSets"`
}
type Flags map[string]Flag
type KindError struct {
	Got	string

	Want	string
}
type Manifest struct {
	APIVersion	string	`json:"apiVersion" yaml:"apiVersion"`

	Kind	string	`json:"kind" yaml:"kind"`

	Channel	string	`json:"channel" yaml:"channel"`

	Generation	uint64	`json:"generation" yaml:"generation"`

	CreatedAt	*"time".Time	`json:"createdAt,omitempty" yaml:"createdAt,omitempty"`

	Objects	[]ManifestObject	`json:"objects" yaml:"objects"`
}
type ManifestObject struct {
	Name	string	`json:"name" yaml:"name"`

	Kind	string	`json:"kind" yaml:"kind"`

	Connection	string	`json:"connection" yaml:"connection"`

	Key	string	`json:"key" yaml:"key"`

	Format	string	`json:"format" yaml:"format"`

	Version	int	`json:"version,omitempty" yaml:"version,omitempty"`

	Checksum	Checksum	`json:"checksum" yaml:"checksum"`

	Size	int64	`json:"size" yaml:"size"`

	VersionID	string	`json:"versionId,omitempty" yaml:"versionId,omitempty"`
}
type MemberList []string
type ProgressiveRollout struct {
	Initial	*ProgressiveRolloutStep	`json:"initial,omitempty" yaml:"initial,omitempty"`
	End	*ProgressiveRolloutStep	`json:"end,omitempty"     yaml:"end,omitempty"`
}
type ProgressiveRolloutStep struct {
	Variation	*string		`json:"variation,omitempty"  yaml:"variation,omitempty"`
	Percentage	*float64	`json:"percentage,omitempty" yaml:"percentage,omitempty"`
	Date		*"time".Time	`json:"date,omitempty"       yaml:"date,omitempty"`
}
type Rule struct {
	Name			*string			`json:"name,omitempty"               yaml:"name,omitempty"`
	Query			*string			`json:"query,omitempty"              yaml:"query,omitempty"`
	Variation		*string			`json:"variation,omitempty"          yaml:"variation,omitempty"`
	Percentage		map[string]float64	`json:"percentage,omitempty"         yaml:"percentage,omitempty"`
	ProgressiveRollout	*ProgressiveRollout	`json:"progressiveRollout,omitempty" yaml:"progressiveRollout,omitempty"`
	Disable			*bool			`json:"disable,omitempty"            yaml:"disable,omitempty"`
	OnError			*string			`json:"onError,omitempty"            yaml:"onError,omitempty"`
}
type ScheduledStep struct {
	Date		*"time".Time		`json:"date,omitempty"            yaml:"date,omitempty"`
	TrackEvents	*bool			`json:"trackEvents,omitempty"     yaml:"trackEvents,omitempty"`
	Disable		*bool			`json:"disable,omitempty"         yaml:"disable,omitempty"`
	Version		*string			`json:"version,omitempty"         yaml:"version,omitempty"`
	Variations	map[string]any		`json:"variations,omitempty"      yaml:"variations,omitempty"`
	Targeting	[]Rule			`json:"targeting,omitempty"       yaml:"targeting,omitempty"`
	BucketingKey	*string			`json:"bucketingKey,omitempty"    yaml:"bucketingKey,omitempty"`
	DefaultRule	*Rule			`json:"defaultRule,omitempty"     yaml:"defaultRule,omitempty"`
	Experimentation	*Experimentation	`json:"experimentation,omitempty" yaml:"experimentation,omitempty"`
	Metadata	map[string]any		`json:"metadata,omitempty"        yaml:"metadata,omitempty"`
}
type SegmentCache struct {
	MaxEntries	int	`json:"maxEntries,omitempty" yaml:"maxEntries,omitempty"`

	TTL	string	`json:"ttl,omitempty" yaml:"ttl,omitempty"`
}
type SegmentDefinition struct {
	Name	string	`json:"name" yaml:"name"`

	Connection	string	`json:"connection,omitempty" yaml:"connection,omitempty"`

	Members	MemberList	`json:"members,omitempty" yaml:"members,omitempty"`

	Mode	string	`json:"mode,omitempty" yaml:"mode,omitempty"`

	Key	string	`json:"key,omitempty" yaml:"key,omitempty"`

	Layout	string	`json:"layout,omitempty" yaml:"layout,omitempty"`

	MissingKey	string	`json:"missingKey,omitempty" yaml:"missingKey,omitempty"`

	OnError	string	`json:"onError,omitempty" yaml:"onError,omitempty"`

	Version	*SegmentVersion	`json:"version,omitempty" yaml:"version,omitempty"`

	Cache	*SegmentCache	`json:"cache,omitempty" yaml:"cache,omitempty"`
}
type SegmentVersion struct {
	Value	string	`json:"value,omitempty" yaml:"value,omitempty"`

	Key	string	`json:"key,omitempty" yaml:"key,omitempty"`

	Interval	string	`json:"interval,omitempty" yaml:"interval,omitempty"`
}
type SegmentsDocument struct {
	APIVersion	string	`json:"apiVersion" yaml:"apiVersion"`

	Kind	string	`json:"kind" yaml:"kind"`

	Segments	[]SegmentDefinition	`json:"segments" yaml:"segments"`
}
type UnsupportedVersionError struct {
	Got	string

	Supported	string
}
type ValidateOption func(*validateConfig)
type ValidationError struct {
	Problems []FieldError
}

	ErrUnsupportedAPIVersion	= "errors".New("controlplane: unsupported apiVersion")

	ErrWrongKind	= "errors".New("controlplane: wrong document kind")

	ErrInvalid	= "errors".New("controlplane: invalid document")

	ErrChecksumMismatch	= "errors".New("controlplane: checksum mismatch")

	ErrUnsupportedChecksum	= "errors".New("controlplane: unsupported checksum algorithm")

	ErrInvalidChecksum	= "errors".New("controlplane: invalid checksum value")

	ErrInvalidExtension	= "errors".New("controlplane: invalid object extension")

	ErrNilDocument	= "errors".New("controlplane: nil document")

	ErrUnsupportedFormat	= "errors".New("controlplane: unsupported format")

	ErrUnsupportedValue	= "errors".New("controlplane: unsupported value")

	ErrDecode	= "errors".New("controlplane: decode")
)

type Error struct {
	Problems []FlagProblem
}
type FlagFile struct {
	Name	string

	Format	string

	Body	[]byte
}
type FlagProblem struct {
	Err	error

	Flag	string
}
type KeylessSet struct {
	Name	string

	Flags	[]FlagFile
}

	Problems []PublicProblem
}

	FlagSet	string

	Object	string
}

	Flag	string

	Owners	[]PublicOwner
}

	FlagSet	string

	Problems	[]ReferenceProblem
}

	Object	string

	Flag	string

	Segment	string

	Reason	string

	Rule	int
}
type SegmentFile struct {
	Doc	*"github.com/blackbirdworks/semaphore/controlplane".SegmentsDocument

	Name	string
}

	StatusPresent	Status	= "present"

	StatusWouldUpload	Status	= "would-upload"

func (e *OperationError) Error() string
func (e *OperationError) Unwrap() error
func (p *Publisher) ManifestKey() string

type API interface {
	GetObject(ctx "context".Context, in *"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3".GetObjectInput, optFns ...func(*"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3".Options)) (*"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3".GetObjectOutput, error)
	HeadObject(ctx "context".Context, in *"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3".HeadObjectInput, optFns ...func(*"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3".Options)) (*"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3".HeadObjectOutput, error)
	PutObject(ctx "context".Context, in *"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3".PutObjectInput, optFns ...func(*"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3".Options)) (*"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3".PutObjectOutput, error)
}
type Config struct {
	Check	func(obj *Object) error

	CheckAll	func(objects []Object) error

	Bucket	string

	Prefix	string

	Channel	string

	Connection	string

	ManifestKey	string

	MaxObjectBytes	int64

	MaxTotalBytes	int64

	MaxManifestBytes	int64

	MaxObjects	int

	Concurrency	int
}
type Object struct {
	Name	string

	Kind	string

	Format	string

	Source	string

	Body	[]byte
}
type ObjectResult struct {
	Name	string
	Key	string
	Status	Status
	Size	int64
}
type OperationError struct {
	Err	error

	Operation	string

	Key	string
}
type Problem struct {
	Object	string

	Key	string

	Code	string

	Detail	string
}
type Publisher struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
type Report struct {
	Channel		string
	ManifestKey	string
	ManifestETag	string

	Problems	[]Problem

	Skipped	[]string

	Requests	Requests
	Generation	uint64

	Attempted	int

	Checked	int
}
type Request struct {
	CreatedAt	*"time".Time

	Objects	[]Object

	Generation	uint64

	DryRun	bool

	ReplaceInvalidManifest	bool
}
type Requests struct {
	Get	int
	Head	int
	Put	int
}
type Result struct {
	Channel		string
	ManifestKey	string

	ManifestETag	string

	Objects	[]ObjectResult

	Warnings	[]string

	Requests	Requests

	Generation	uint64

	Previous	uint64

	UploadedBytes	int64

	Uploaded	int
	Present		int

	Changed	bool

	Written	bool

	DryRun	bool
}
type Status string
var (
	ErrInvalid	= "errors".New("s3publish: invalid documents")

	ErrConfig	= "errors".New("s3publish: invalid configuration")

	ErrConflict	= "errors".New("s3publish: the manifest changed since it was read")

	ErrGeneration	= "errors".New("s3publish: generation does not increase")

	ErrChannelMismatch	= "errors".New("s3publish: the manifest in the bucket has another channel")

	ErrPreviousManifest	= "errors".New("s3publish: the manifest in the bucket is not readable")

	ErrObjectMismatch	= "errors".New("s3publish: an object exists with other content")

	ErrLimit	= "errors".New("s3publish: over a limit of the reader")

	ErrManifestKey	= "errors".New("s3publish: an object has the key of the manifest")

	ErrNoManifest	= "errors".New("s3publish: no manifest in the bucket")
)
